newsitem.title: DENMARK: East Asiatic sells Brazil packaging unit.
newsitem.headline: East Asiatic sells Brazil packaging unit.

text.p: Danish trading group East Asiatic Company(EAC) said on Wednesday it sold its 85 percent stake in its Brazilian packaging unit Este Asiatico Comercio e Industria to Denmark's Broedrene Hartmann for 188.6 million crowns.

"The sale is a natural continuation of EAC's strategy to concentrate on the group's three core activities -- EAC Graphics, EAC Consumer Products and EAC Foods -- along with activities with special potential for the company," EAC said in a statement.
EAC said the divestment to Hartmann, a leading Danish packager, was not expected to have any major effect on the group's 1997 results.
The Danish state's Industrialisation Fund for Developing Countries (IFU) owns the remaining 15 percent of the Brazilian company.
